name: Number Bases
description: Convert between decimal, binary, hexadecimal and octal as you type, and flip bits with a tap to see what changes.
prompt: A number base converter: decimal, binary, hexadecimal and octal fields that update each other as you type, tappable bits, shift, NOT and +1 buttons, and the number shown as a character, a colour and a signed 16-bit value.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Convierte entre decimal, binario, hexadecimal y octal mientras escribes, y cambia bits con un toque para ver qué pasa.
